name: BlueAmp

source.authors: Hermann Meyer, James Warden, Andreas Degert, Pete Shorthose and the Guitarix project; packaged by Hermann Meyer (brummer10)

purpose: Guitarix model of a clean to slightly breaking-up blues amp. Warm, dynamic and open; push master for edge. The clean guitar sound. Follow with gx_ultracab.

params.name: Master
params.ai_hint: Power-stage drive. Around 0.3 is clean, 0.5 edge of breakup, above 0.7 bluesy overdrive.

params.name: Tone
params.ai_hint: 0.5 is neutral. Lower for a darker, warmer sound, raise for brightness.

notes: Port names and ranges come from the Guitarix plug-in (all 0..1); defaults are the plug-in's own.
CPU: under 2% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
